name: padded shirt
_design_note: Under-armor slot. Worn beneath body armor or standalone. Gambeson/chain-shirt are both this template — material is the variation axis. Distributes impact, mitigates seam-blows.
lore_template: A fitted shirt of {material_name}, quilted or woven dense, worn as both a standalone garment and as padding beneath heavier armor. Distributes impact across a wide area — the true value is revealed when a blade finds the seam in a breastplate and instead of drawing blood, it meets the shirt and glances away.
